name: One-pot cottage & garlic-confit pasta — optimized (פסטה קוטג' ושום קונפי, ממוטבת)

source.author: Optimized version of cottage_garlic_confit_pasta
source.notes: Optimized version of cottage_garlic_confit_pasta, adopted per user request (original stays as reference). Changes chosen by the user: pasta → 400 g whole-spelt pasta (from 500 g white), cottage 5% → 3%, yellow cheese 150 → 100 g, NO added salt, lemon zest to finish, and NO confit-oil drizzle at serving. Kept: 3 tbsp garlic confit + 1 tbsp of its oil in the pot, pepper, chili, a little parmesan. No spinach/mushrooms (user's choice). 8 servings. Estimate.

ingredients.qty: 1 tbsp (in the pot only — no drizzle at serving)

steps: Put the spelt pasta in a wide pot; spread the cottage, yellow cheese and garlic confit over it, add 1 tbsp confit oil and season with pepper and chili (no salt).
Pour 2 cups water evenly over the pot and stir lightly so it reaches the bottom.
Cover and bring to a boil on high; once boiling, stir gently so nothing sticks.
Lower to medium-low and cook covered 4–5 min; uncover, stir and adjust with ¼–½ cup water if dry.
Cook uncovered until the pasta is done and the sauce coats it (whole-spelt pasta may need a few minutes more); turn off, cover and rest 5 min.
Finish with lemon zest, fresh herbs and a little parmesan. Taste — add salt only if really needed.

batch_totals.note: Whole pot (8 servings), optimized. Vs the original (per serving ~448 kcal / 27.9 g protein / 52.7 g carb / 2 g fibre / ~998 mg sodium): ~110 kcal less, ~12 g fewer carbs, ~2x the fibre, sodium roughly halved, ~3 g less protein (less pasta and cheese). ~7.4 g protein per 100 kcal.

him.verdict: A much leaner version of the same creamy one-pot pasta: ~25 g protein for ~338 kcal (~7.4 g protein per 100 kcal, up from 6.2), with ~4 g fibre from whole-spelt pasta and sodium roughly halved by dropping the added salt. Cottage 3% and less yellow cheese trim the fat; lemon zest keeps it bright without salt. Still no vegetables — pair with a salad.
suggested_mods: Serve with a big salad for fibre and micronutrients

her_preconception.verdict: Good protein and calcium, pasteurized cheeses, fully cooked, and sodium is now much lower. Whole spelt adds a little folate and iron. Keep homemade garlic confit refrigerated and use it within about a week.

safety_advisories.note: Homemade garlic confit must be refrigerated and used within ~1 week (botulism risk at room temperature).

adopted_note: Adopted 2026-11-20 (optimized). Per serving (of 8, ~240 g): ~338 kcal, 25.1 g protein, 40.9 g carb, 9.2 g fat, 4.2 g fibre, ~528 mg sodium. him 8 / her 7. Standing spec: 400 g whole-spelt pasta, 1 kg cottage 3%, 100 g yellow 9%, 3 tbsp garlic confit + 1 tbsp confit oil in the pot, no added salt, lemon zest to finish, no oil drizzle at serving, a little parmesan.
cooking_guide: Use a WIDE pot and a short pasta shape so it cooks evenly and the cottage doesn't scorch.
Stir down to the bottom right when it boils — the moment things stick.
Whole-spelt pasta absorbs a bit more water and takes a little longer; add water ¼ cup at a time and taste.
Zest the lemon over the pot right at the end — heat dulls the oils in the zest.
Taste before salting: with no added salt, the cheeses and parmesan usually season it enough.
Rest 5 minutes covered; it thickens as it stands. Reheat with a splash of water.
